summary.text: Ben Bowman is a Democratic state representative from District 25 who has represented the district since January 9, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
He appears on the November 3, 2026 ballot with Democratic and Working Families Party nominations.

paragraphs.text: Ben Bowman was born in Portland, Oregon, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oregon in 2014 and a graduate degree from Stanford University in 2018.
His career experience includes work as an innovation and partnership strategist at the Oregon Department of Education.
